input.title: Give the colour filter select an accessible name
input.rationale: The visible <label>Filter by colour</label> on line 13 has no for="g-filter" attribute and doesn't wrap the select, so it isn't linked to the control. That leaves the select with no accessible name. I can only edit the element at offset 529 (the select), so I'm adding aria-label="Filter by colour". This uses the same words as the visible label, so voice-control users can say what they see. A better fix, which needs an edit outside this element, would be to add for="g-filter" to the existing <label>. Once that's done, the aria-label could be removed. Please check the result with a screen reader.
